description: Second A1 content batch for The Sound Maze. Each target is spoken aloud; the learner selects its spelling. Draft content is not wired into the live game.

questions.explain: Ship has the short /ɪ/ sound. Sheep has /iː/, shop has /ɑ/, and sip has the same vowel but a different final consonant.
Bed has the short /ɛ/ sound. Bad has /æ/, bid has /ɪ/, and bud has /ʌ/.
Cup has the /ʌ/ vowel and ends in /p/. Cap and cop have different vowels, while cut ends in /t/.
Thin begins with /θ/, the unvoiced th sound. Tin begins with /t/, fin with /f/, and sin with /s/.
Man begins with /m/. Can begins with /k/, pan with /p/, and van with /v/.
Goat begins with the voiced /g/ sound. Coat begins with /k/, boat with /b/, and note with /n/.
Leaf ends with the unvoiced /f/ sound. Leave ends with /v/, leak with /k/, and lean with /n/.
Pack ends with /k/. Pad ends with /d/, pat with /t/, and pan with /n/.
Rice ends with the unvoiced /s/ sound. Ride ends with /d/, ripe with /p/, and rise with the voiced /z/ sound.
Time uses i followed by a consonant and a final silent e to spell the /aɪ/ sound. Team has /iː/, tub has /ʌ/, and tame has /eɪ/.
Snow uses ow to spell the /oʊ/ sound. Now has /aʊ/, sun has /ʌ/, and slow uses the same vowel sound with a different first consonant.
Light uses igh to spell the /aɪ/ sound. Late has /eɪ/, let has /ɛ/, and lot has /ɑ/.
